Old Louisville Brick Victorian

Stop 1

Tall brick, tall plaster, a porch that has settled.

A century of Kentucky summers works on the same three places in these houses: the porch floor, the plaster walls and the old door hardware. We fix those without tearing out what is original.

  1. 1

    Porch floor and rail repair

    Rotted boards replaced, rails tightened and spindles secured so your porch is safe for Derby season.

  2. 2

    Drywall patches and paint touch-ups

    Plaster cracks patched, holes filled and paint matched so the repair disappears in old walls.

  3. 3

    Door and window fixes

    Sticking doors planed, drafty windows weatherstripped and old hardware adjusted to work again.

Price a porch visit
Germantown Wood cottage

Stop 2

Cottages move with the seasons. Doors and drips follow.

Wood frame cottages swell in July and shrink in January. The screen door starts to drag, the kitchen faucet starts to drip. Both are short visits.

  1. 1

    Screen door adjustment

    Sagging wooden screen doors re-hung, closers replaced and latches aligned for a clean close.

  2. 2

    Minor plumbing fixes

    Leaky faucets, running toilets and tub caulk refreshed. Anything past the shutoff valve goes to a plumber.

Price a door visit

Highlands Bungalow

Stop 3

Twelve-foot ceilings. We bring the long ladder.

Bungalow hallways run tall and their walls are plaster over lath, so a fan swap or a TV mount needs the right ladder and the right anchor. We check the box and the studs before anything goes up.

  1. 1

    Ceiling fan and light fixture swaps

    Fans and lights swapped on existing boxes in tall rooms, with no new circuits or panel work.

  2. 2

    TV and shelf mounting

    TVs, shelves and mirrors hung level into studs or the right anchors for plaster walls.

Where we stop

New circuits, panel work, gas lines, main water lines and anything structural go to a specialist trade. If your list has one of those, we say so before we start, not halfway through.

Crescent Hill Foursquare

Stop 4

Big square houses, long lists.

Foursquares change hands, and every sale brings an inspection report. New owners bring flat-pack furniture for four big rooms. One visit can clear both.
